<!-- docs-drift-check -->
### 📓 Docs Drift Check
Nothing in this diff resolved to a documentable surface (no symbol, route or SDK anchor derived from **1** changed package(s)), so **this run has no opinion** about the docs.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **2** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **137** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 6bff748bbd484f00906c8d9a58f5a3621a20c2e6` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `17e3b7eadbdacd3777c44f1c08a426f1cd9c28a0`
Local-runs: none

Post-hoc record by the director seat (objectstack#12708, `session_01AsCNgFBs8HCjwhyHQsFbx3`), on the maintainer's word 「20664 补记录」 (2026-09-30), after the director's audit found this PR landed on a review face with no same-form record: the landing record 5895924349 on #20649 says "no at-tier review: this is ledger text only", but `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/**` is `packages/spec/src/**` non-test and `.changeset/*.md` is changeset prose — two of the five review faces (`contract-review.md`), whatever the `Clause-②` line says. The head reviewed is the PR head `17e3b7eadb`, squash-merged as `ace770d5fc` at 2026-09-29T16:37Z with the same `git patch-id --stable` per file (the landing record's own check; re-read here: the three files' diffs against merge base `6bff748bbd` are the ones below). Inputs: card #20649 (body, triage 5891809598 / 5893411445, claim 5893513927, the os-dev-report 5894384859 and the landing record, the last two read as claims to test), the PR body and its 3-file diff, `packages/cli/src/commands/{dev,start}.ts` at `origin/main`, the head's check-runs. Nothing built, run or re-run.

Check-runs on the head: 44, 0 failure, 0 in progress (the rest success or skipped by path filter). `Lint & Repo Gates` carries `check:migration-registry --check`, so the entry file and its generated copy in `migrations/registry.ts` agree on this head.

### ① Derived judgments

- **The sentence — RIGHT, as a necessary condition.** The `reason` of `ui-html-page-div-refused` (printed by `objectstack migrate meta` as `why:`) no longer says `dev` and `start` run `objectstack compile` first; it says they run it "before they boot only when the artifact is missing or `--compile` is passed, and `dev`'s watch mode when a watched file changes". Verified at `origin/main`: `dev.ts:319` `needsCompile = !flags.artifact && (flags.compile || !fs.existsSync(artifactPath))`, the watcher active at `:383` / `:703` and rebuilding on change; `start.ts:228-232` `!flags.artifact && !process.env.OS_ARTIFACT_PATH && (flags.compile || !artifactSource)`. Compile ⇒ (artifact missing ∨ `--compile`) holds on both commands, which is what "only when" claims. Precision note, not a defect: with `--artifact` (or `OS_ARTIFACT_PATH` on `start`) set, `--compile` is ignored, so the condition is necessary, not sufficient; the dev measured that arm by running the CLI (report 5894384859) and the sentence does not claim it. The card's own re-check ("run first": 0 hits in `packages/spec/src`) holds on `main` today.
- **Two copies, one text.** The entry file and the `os-generated semantic:18` copy in `registry.ts` carry the identical three-line change; the generated copy was regenerated (`gen:migration-registry`), not hand-edited, and the `--check` gate is green at the head. No other sentence in the entry moves; `id`, `surface`, `replacement`, `acceptanceCriteria` and the D2 links are untouched.
- **Public surface.** `@objectstack/spec`: one string literal in a published ledger entry changes; no key, export, type or accept set moves. The pending changeset `20592-ui-html-page-div-refused.md` (Version Packages #20639) never carried the wrong phrase, so no pending changeset is corrected — the claim's own serial-constraint line, re-read.
- **Statements tested.** The changeset's sentences are the same condition, and are true on `main`; the PR body's "the two places the sentence lived" is the `git grep` count (2, then 0). The landing record's timing claim (landed before #20639 merged, so the next release carries the corrected text) holds: #20639 is still open at this read.

### ② Semver level

Clause-②: no

`.changeset/20649-div-entry-compile-condition.md`: `@objectstack/spec` **patch**, `Clause-②: no` with no arm — right: a wrong published sentence corrected, nothing widened or narrowed, no ADR-0087 disposition owed (no authorable shape moves; the entry's id and links are unchanged). One package named, the one that publishes. The changeset gates were green at the head.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **The landing record's "no at-tier review: ledger text only" — answered — WRONG as a rule, harmless in this instance.** The review face is decided by the path (`packages/spec/src/**` non-test, `.changeset` prose), not by `Clause-②`; this record closes the gap. The text landed is right, so nothing is owed on `main`.
- **The dev's out-of-scope finding (`dev`'s `watch` flag has no `allowNo`, so the `--watch=false` opt-out the code checks is unreachable): answered — carried, filed as #20681** by the seat.
- **Concurrency on `migrations/registry.ts`** (PRs #20660, #20635 at claim time): ordinary; the copy is regenerated, and the gate holds on `main`.
- **Precision note above** (the `--artifact` / `OS_ARTIFACT_PATH` arms): recorded here; not a head move on merged text, and the sentence is not false.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-20649-div-entry-compile-condition`
Reviewed-by: `session_01AsCNgFBs8HCjwhyHQsFbx3`

**VERDICT: PASS**
